insurer_name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: PED 48 months under this earlier UIN; subsequent variant brought it to 36 months

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Covered up to Sum Insured; no room rent capping

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All day care procedures + Modern Treatments up to SI

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road ambulance up to Rs 2,000 per hospitalisation; Air ambulance up to Rs 2,50,000

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Refill Benefit — one-time reinstatement equal to Base Sum Insured for unrelated illness

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Annual checkup from day 1 with sliding limit by SI band

notable_exclusions_summary: Earlier Health Companion variant with 48-month PED waiting; no room rent cap; 60/180 day pre/post hospitalisation; Refill benefit for unrelated illness only.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via Niva Bupa network with pre-auth via hospital; reimbursement via app or document submission within prescribed timeline.
